description.value: Wildeye Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom in North Vancouver with a wide rotating lineup of house-brewed beers spanning Czech Pilsners, hazy IPAs, creative sours, and stouts, alongside a full bistro menu and bar snacks. The venue regularly hosts live music, trivia nights, and line dancing events, and can accommodate private groups of up to 75. A dedicated non-alcoholic 'Easy Series' beer line — marketed explicitly for active occasions including hitting the trails — makes it a welcoming stop for cyclists who prefer to ride dry.
